definition: Core Glossary: Lifts and Jacks — the working vocabulary of Lifts and Jacks: 10 terms with plain definitions, runnable as a demo..
key_points: Journeyman: A fully qualified tradesperson past apprenticeship.
Rough-in: The early install phase before walls close.
Trim-out: The finish phase: fixtures, covers, final connections.
Torque spec: The maker-stated tightening force for a fastener.
Shutoff: The valve or breaker isolating a system for safe work.
Snaking: Clearing drains with a rotating auger cable.
Fishing: Pulling wire through walls with fish tape or rods.
Receptacle: The outlet device delivering power at the point of use.
Refrigerant: The working fluid in cooling systems; licensed handling only.
Combustion analysis: Measuring burner efficiency and safety with a flue-gas analyzer.
